Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_group_site_id VARCHAR2(7);
 temp_drive_id VARCHAR2(6);
 temp_contract_type VARCHAR2(2);
begin
 if :product_info.s_unit_id is null then
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and nvl(warehouse_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse) = :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 IF temp_count = 0
 THEN
 show_error_dist('0312');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from units
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if temp_count = 0
 then
 show_error_dist('0312'); -- Invalid unit ID
 check_package_failure;
 else
 begin
 select max(coll_date), group_site_id,
 substr(contract_id,4,2), drive_id
 into :coll_date, temp_group_site_id,
 temp_contract_type,temp_drive_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 group by group_site_id, contract_id, drive_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 show_error_dist('0307'); -- invalid collection date
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :s_coll_date := :coll_date;
 if temp_group_site_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select osok_flag into :GLOBAL.osok_flag
 from group_sites
 where group_site_id = temp_group_site_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('error in statement 1a');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 :GLOBAL.osok_flag := '';
 end if;
 if temp_drive_id is not null 
 and nvl(:global.osok_flag,'Y')='Y'
 then
 begin
 select osok_flag into :GLOBAL.osok_flag
 from drives_lab
 where drive_id = temp_drive_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('error in statement 1ab');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if temp_contract_type = 'IM'
 then
 :GLOBAL.import_flag := 'Y';
 else
 :GLOBAL.import_flag := '';
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in statement 1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 END IF;
 
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_aliquot number;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
--For code 128 assigning last two characters of product code to aliquot .
 IF :global.code_scheme = 'I' THEN
 :product_info.aliquot := substr(:product_info.product_code,7,2) ;
 go_item('product_info.aliquot');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM'); 
 ELSIF :global.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 begin
 select max(aliquot)
 into temp_aliquot
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in statement 2');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_aliquot = 1
 then
 :GLOBAL.one_aliquot := 'TRUE';
 GO_ITEM('aliquot');
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ALIQUOT',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ALIQUOT', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 else
 :aliquot := '';
 :GLOBAL.one_aliquot := 'FALSE';
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ALIQUOT', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ALIQUOT',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'ALIQUOT', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
 END IF;
 if nvl(:GLOBAL.osok_flag,'Y') = 'Y'
 then
 begin
--Modified for both the schemes to coexist.

 select distinct out_of_state_flag
 into :GLOBAL.osok_flag
 from vserv_products
 where out_of_state_flag = 'N'
 and product_code = substr(:product_info.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme ;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('error in getting out of state flag');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if nvl(:global.osok_flag,'Y')='N' then
 begin
 select nvl(osok_flag,'N') into :global.osok_flag from
 equipment where nvl(osok_flag,'N')='Y' and
 equip_reference in (select equip_reference 
 from component_cgmp where unit_id=:unit_id and
 parm_code='PHER') and equip_type in
 (select equip_type from valid_prodequip_cgmp where
 product_code=:product_code and parm_code='OSOK'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)); -- Added by Sobha PR No.001.020411
 :global.osok_flag:=null;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 null;
 when OTHERS then
 message('error in getting out of state flag');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_exp_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
--Check for the length of product_code depending on the coding scheme
 IF :global.code_scheme = 'I' and NVL(length( :product_info.product_code), 0) != 8 THEN
 show_error_dist('9803'); -- invalid length of product code for code 128
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :global.code_scheme = 'C' and NVL(length( :product_info.product_code), 0) != 5 THEN
 show_error_dist('9804'); -- invalid length of product code for codabar
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 begin
--Modified for both the schemes to coexist
 select inv_product_type
 into :product_info.product_type
 from vserv_products
 where product_code = substr(:product_info.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme 
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0309'); -- invalid product code
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in statement 3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 declare
 checked_in exception;
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from active_products ap
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and not exists (select distinct 'x'
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and aliquot != ap.aliquot);
 
 raise checked_in;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and nvl(exp_date,sysdate + 1) > sysdate
 and nvl(warehouse_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse) = :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from discard_products
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :coll_date
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and product_code = :product_code
 and nvl(warehouse_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse) = :GLOBAL.warehouse;
 show_error_dist('5106');
 check_package_failure;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('3717');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end;
 when checked_in
 then
 show_error_dist('5322'); -- Product already checked in
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in statement 3');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

DECLARE
 temp_v_product_type varchar2(30);
 temp_v_pool_prod_code varchar2(10);
 temp_system_label_decision varchar2(5);
 b_pool boolean := FALSE;
BEGIN
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 --Check if the first two characters of product_type are PO then pooled component

BEGIN
 select system_label_decision
 into temp_system_label_decision
 from components
 where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id
 and coll_date = :product_info.coll_date
 and product_code = :product_info.product_code
 and component_prefix = :product_info.aliquot
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;
 IF temp_system_label_decision is null
 THEN 
 BEGIN
 SELECT product_type, nvl(pool_product_code,'N')
 INTO temp_v_product_type, temp_v_pool_prod_code
 FROM vserv_products
 WHERE product_code = substr(:product_info.product_code,1,5)
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme 
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 EXCEPTION
 when OTHERS then
 null;
 END;
 IF :global.code_scheme = 'C' THEN
 IF temp_v_pool_prod_code = 'Y'
 THEN
 b_pool := TRUE;
 END IF;
 /*ELSE ----Commented by Sobha as per KIM
 IF substr(temp_v_product_type,1,2) = 'PO' THEN 
 b_pool := TRUE;
 end if;*/
 END IF; 
 ELSE
 b_pool := FALSE;
 END IF;
 IF b_pool
 THEN
 :s_abo_desc := 'POOL';
 :product_info.blood_type := 'PO';
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO_DESC', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO_DESC', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO', NAVIGABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_ABO_DESC',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_ABO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO_DESC', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('S_ABO_DESC',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'S_ABO_DESC', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_TRUE );
 END IF;
 NEXT_ITEM;
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_abo VARCHAR2(5);
 temp_abo_desc VARCHAR2(50);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if NVL(length(:s_abo), 0) != 5 and
 NVL(length(:s_abo), 0) != 6 and
 upper(:s_abo) != 'M'
 then
 :s_abo := '';
 :product_info.blood_type := '';
 :s_abo_desc := '';
 show_error_dist('0700'); -- invalid scan length
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if NVL(length(:s_abo), 0) = 5
 then
 validate_abo_scan_codabar(:s_abo,
 temp_abo,
 temp_abo_desc);
 if form_failure
 then
 :s_abo := '';
 :product_info.blood_type := '';
 :s_abo_desc := '';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 IF NVL(length(:s_abo), 0) = 6
 then
 validate_abo_scan_code128(:s_abo,
 temp_abo,
 temp_abo_desc);
 if form_failure
 then
 :s_abo := '';
 :product_info.blood_type := '';
 :s_abo_desc := '';
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 :product_info.blood_type := temp_abo;
 :s_abo_desc := temp_abo_desc;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FOR_INTERDICTIONS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_for_interdictions(p_unit_id in VARCHAR2,
 p_coll_date in date,
 p_product_code in VARCHAR2,
 p_aliquot in varchar2) is
 temp_count number;
 temp_prod_count number;
 temp_label_dats date;
 temp_label VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 begin
 select nvl(label_dats,sysdate-1000000), system_label_decision
 into temp_label_dats, temp_label
 from components
 where unit_id = p_unit_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and component_prefix = p_aliquot;
 end;
 --
 -- Check if unit has interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from unit_interdictions ui, valid_interdictions_lab vi
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and ui.inter_code = vi.inter_code
 and vi.inter_type != 'I'
 and (vi.inter_type != 'B' or temp_label not in ('40','71'))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1725'); -- unit interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 
 --
 -- check for component interdictions
 --
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_prod_count
 from component_interdictions
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and unit_id = p_unit_id
 and coll_date = p_coll_date
 and product_code = p_product_code
 and insert_dats > temp_label_dats;
 if temp_prod_count > 0
 then
 show_error_dist('1724'); -- component interdicted
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Get_base_abo_value (p_actual_blood_type IN varchar2,
 p_base_blood_type OUT varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if (p_actual_blood_type = '71' and :global.code_scheme = 'C') or 
 --Codes for EMERGENCY blood type for code 128
 (p_actual_blood_type in ('92','48','03','59','14','70','25','81','P3','A3','B3','C3') 
 and :global.code_scheme = 'I')
 or p_actual_blood_type = 'PO'
 then
 p_base_blood_type := p_actual_blood_type;
 return;
 end if; 

 SELECT distinct abo_label
 INTO p_base_blood_type
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only)
 in (SELECT tested_abo_code,abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = p_actual_blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme)
 AND identifier_code = 'RG'
 AND unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 show_error_dist('0300');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 END;

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select blood_type, abo_desc, to_char(exp_date,'mm/dd/yyyy hh24:mi') exp_date from discard_products c, vserv_abo v where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id and product_code = :product_info.product_code and aliquot = :product_info.aliquot and coll_date = :product_info.coll_date and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and c.blood_type = v.abo_code and v.unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365) and nvl(warehouse_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse) = :GLOBAL.warehouse order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: PRODUCT_INF_ALIQUOT_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select aliquot component_prefix from discard_products c where unit_id = :product_info.unit_id and coll_date = :coll_date and product_code = :product_code and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and not exists (select 'x' from active_products a where a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id and a.unit_id = c.unit_id and a.product_code = c.product_code and a.aliquot = c.aliquot and a.coll_date = c.coll_date) and nvl(c.warehouse_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse) = :GLOBAL.warehouse order by 1

RecordGroup.Name: PRODUCT_INF_PRODUCT_COD_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct c.product_code, inv_product_type from vserv_products v, discard_products c where c.unit_id = :product_info.unit_id and c.coll_date = :coll_date and c.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and ((blood_type is not null) or (blood_type is null and v.product_type like '%PO%')) and unit_scheme_type = :global.code_scheme and nvl(c.blood_type,'PO') not in ('Mq','Mb','Mx','39','47') and not exists (select 'x' from active_products a where a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id and a.unit_id = c.unit_id and a.product_code = c.product_code and a.aliquot = c.aliquot and a.coll_date = c.coll_date) and substr(c.product_code,1,5) = v.product_code and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate) and nvl(c.warehouse_id, :GLOBAL.warehouse) = :GLOBAL.warehouse order by c.product_code

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_code number;
 temp_msg VARCHAR2(80);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('0213');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('0214');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('0216');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('0217');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('0218');
 elsif error_code = 40209 -- invalid entry format
 then
 show_error_dist('0246');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('0000');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0601');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026,0)
 then
 declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(20);
 begin
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2))='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0251',disp_format_mask);
 show_error_dist('0251',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 end;
 elsif error_code = 50025 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('0509');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('0220');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('0331');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;
 else -- unhandled Forms errors
 message('FRMS ' || to_char(error_code) || ':' || error_text);
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
end;
